{{Top|leg}}
'''Amplification crystals''' were a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] used in the construction of the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. The superlaser was powered by a massive [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] at the core of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], which used the amplification crystals to generate<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> eight individual beams of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] pulses that converged over the [[central focus lens]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Eight amplification crystals were used for the superlaser aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], and each crystal required a separate gunnery station to calibrate and modulate the pulses. Fourteen [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] manned each individual station, with an additional four additional amplification crystals held in reserve.<ref name="EGWT" />
